stil: Painterly ornamental pattern for the back of a playing card, painted in rich oil colours with fine gold line work, medieval tavern and fairy-tale kingdom mood. This image is the TOP-LEFT QUARTER of the card back: the ornament grows from the bottom-right corner of the image (which will be the centre of the card) outwards, and a decorative border runs along the top edge and the left edge only. Flat, evenly lit, no perspective, no shadows. No text, no letters, no numbers, no figures, no faces.
